turns.prompt: Fit the nonlinear model y = b1 * (1-(1+2*b2*x)**(-.5)) to the data in misra1c.csv (columns x, y) by least squares, starting from b1 = 500, b2 = 0.0001. Report every parameter (b1, b2) to at least 6 significant digits and the residual sum of squares as rss.

provenance: NIST StRD Misra1c (public domain), data copied verbatim
